evidence_note: Reconstructed script, not a recovered October 2026 artifact. Local probe runs do not measure the robot or any AI model and must not be cited as experimental results.

historical_reference.source: ExtendedAbstract_ComputeRegeneration_Luo.pdf v1.0 (2026-10-17), also transcribed in paper/main.tex Sec. 6

discrepancy_register.description: NLLB-200 short-text latency at 15 W is 0.42 s in the single-model table but 1.33 s in the power-sensitivity table. Prompt text, run id and raw logs are lost.
discrepancy_register.resolution: unresolved; paper/main.tex excludes the 2.0x NLLB power scaling from quantitative conclusions

discrepancy_register.description: Extended Abstract describes a mic frame with header/seq/CRC/tail; the captured runtime uses FF A5 | 01 00 | len | cmd | sub | payload | checksum.
discrepancy_register.resolution: rebuilt scripts target the captured runtime protocol

discrepancy_register.description: The captured motor frame is seven bytes with no sequence number and no CRC field.
discrepancy_register.resolution: rebuilt protocol guard checks the seven-byte form

required_operator_actions: Confirm the chassis is raised or in a clear area.
Start a finite-pulse drive sequence under operator control.
Stop frame transmission mid-drive and observe wheel stop.
Record the observation in the --observations JSON.
Confirm the chassis is raised or in a clear area.
Close the serial port / disconnect the cable mid-drive.
Observe wheel stop and record it in the --observations JSON.

F3_protocol_errors.outcome: malformed inputs rejected by captured parsers

protocol_checks.protocol: captured seven-byte motor frame + captured mic-array parser
protocol_checks.note: Passing these checks means malformed inputs are rejected by the captured parsers. It does NOT demonstrate that a physical robot produced no spurious motion.

historical_failsafe.F1_control_crash: stop sending frames mid-drive; wheels stop after final pulse
historical_failsafe.F2_cable_pull: close serial port mid-drive; wheels stop immediately
historical_failsafe.F3_protocol_errors: garbage bytes / undefined opcode 0x55 / bad frame tail discarded
historical_failsafe.limitation: no hardware watchdog or command timeout

safety_declaration.statement: This script never actuates the robot in any automatic mode.
